_about: Critical and high advisories on production dependencies that `pnpm audit --prod` reports and we have decided not to fix, read by `pnpm check-advisories` (scripts/check-dependency-advisories.ts, whose header says why).

Keys are GitHub advisory ids. Each needs a reason and a point to look again. Moderate and low advisories need no entry: they are printed and never fail. An entry for an advisory that is no longer reported is a warning, so delete it.

GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q.reason: postcss 8.4.31 is pinned exactly by next@15.5.x, so only a Next release can move it. The file read needs attacker-controlled CSS naming a sourceMappingURL; postcss runs at build time on CSS from this repo and its locked dependencies, never on a request.
GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q.revisit: when a next release depends on postcss >= 8.5.12

GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849.reason: Same postcss 8.4.31 that next@15.5.x pins exactly. Path traversal in previous source map auto-loading needs attacker-controlled CSS; the build parses only this repo's CSS and its locked dependencies, never a request's.
